content_text: Google Cloud Console — APIs & Services > Credentials. Page shows API keys, OAuth 2.0 client IDs, and service accounts. Tip: restrict keys by HTTP referrer or IP.
Cloudflare Dashboard — WAF overview. Sections: Managed rules, Rate limiting, Bot Fight Mode. A banner suggests enabling "Super Bot Fight Mode" for additional protection.
Slack API — Conversations. Endpoints: conversations.list, conversations.history, conversations.replies. Notes scopes: channels:read, groups:read, mpim:read.
Sentry Docs — JavaScript SDK. Setup with npm install @sentry/browser. Notes DSN config, source maps upload, session replay, and performance tracing configuration.
The Pragmatic Engineer — recent posts include "Incident review template" and "Hiring senior engineers". A note about paid subscriptions and RSS feed availability appears in the header.
Apple docs: SFSafariViewController for presenting web content in-app. Notes cookie sharing, reader mode availability, and delegate callbacks for dismiss events.
npm page for ulid. Shows version, weekly downloads, install command, and README snippet describing lexicographically sortable unique IDs and monotonic factory.
Google Cloud console: IAM & Admin > Service Accounts. Table shows service accounts, keys, and last used. A warning suggests rotating keys and using Workload Identity.
Cloudflare Rate Limiting rule builder. Fields: expression, threshold, period, mitigation action. A toast reads "Saved" after updating the threshold value.
